mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 55-degree temperatures with overcast skies near Verona City Hall, under a lovely waxing gibbous moon.

Starting September 23, the city is conducting chip seal road maintenance. Work areas include Cross Country Road and parts of East Verona Avenue, so please use caution as crews will be present between 9 AM and 3 PM.
Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, there are plenty of trivia options at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market.
On September 5, Verona officers responded to reports of vehicles being pranked with cheese slices, which they learned is part of a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed, but they will open today at 10:00 AM to serve up today's flavor of the day.
